fusions.name: Head-Down Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 8 tiles away, then deals 15 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Tread of the Herd
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Lead-Cow's Clang
fusions.desc: Strikes a bell: up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Draught-Ox Shoulders

riders.text: more of you behind every swing
and it mends at its own pace

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises by 10, from silver your health recovers 15% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 5%.
